title: Forty
transcript:
Forty screens. Forty grey men in the same grey clothes.
One climbs the yard fence and is pulled down by the ankle.
One runs the length of the laundry, finds the door locked, and sits down against it.
One stands at the edge of the pool for an hour and never goes in.

The timestamps say they are all him.

Cycle 17: he waits out the guard change in the laundry and crosses the east walk unseen.
Cycle 33: he moves behind the HQ generator while the south tower lamp swings away.

He watches himself get further than he ever remembered getting.
Then he watches himself get caught.
